audience: library staff who keep patrons and managers in a Libib Pro account

useCases.title: Find patrons and check frozen accounts
useCases.text: List patrons, 50 per page, with their barcode, tags and freeze status. Open one patron by barcode or email to read the full record.

useCases.title: Review who manages the library account
useCases.text: List the account and every manager with their role, or look up one manager by email address.

useCases.title: Add a new patron
useCases.text: Create a patron from a first name and last name. Libib assigns the barcode, and you set the patron password in Libib.

useCases.title: Correct a patron's contact details
useCases.text: Update fields of one patron, found by barcode or email. Leave a field out to keep it. An empty value clears that field.
